profile.headline: Software Engineer | AI/ML Engineer in Training | Open to AI/ML Roles
profile.summary:
A well-qualified, dedicated, and passionate lead engineer of several successful design and system implementations and projects from beginning to end. Possesses a strong understanding of full stack web application, RESTful APIs, object-oriented design and development in embedded systems, full stack development used to determine the best solutions for key projects. Recognized as an active listener and strategic communicator with a proven record of completing projects on schedule and on budget. 
A bi-lingual (French/English) professional skilled in multiple programming languages to include Python, Java and MySQL. Adept at reducing technology risk, identifying inefficiencies, escalating risk/issues, and removing constraints at overseeing multiple strategic projects from conception to completion.
